case_title.quote: Pradeep Kumar v. State of Haryana

number_of_accused.quote: The sole appellant herein was tried along with another accused
number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided in the Supreme Court.

accused_gender.quote: The Appellant is acquitted of all charges, and his bail bonds
accused_gender.reason: The appellant is referred to as 'his'; the accused are described as young boys.

accused_age.reason: No age of the appellant is stated.

accused_occupation.reason: The appellant's occupation is not stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No class or wealth statement about the accused.

victim_gender.quote: the deceased lying there, with his throat having knotted

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not given.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: he borrowed money from the deceased and as such there was pressure on him to return the money
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The loan was by co-accused A-2; no relationship between the appellant and the victim is established.

offence_category.quote: convicted under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 for murder

weapon.quote: the weapons recovered by the IO and the ones seen by the witnesses are only sticks
weapon.reason: Sticks are the only weapons; the incise-wound point is also accurate.

evidence_type.quote: the case of the prosecution is based only on circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: The listed evidence types are all described in the judgment.

confession.quote: the extra judicial confession on 17.04.2004 is false and unbelievable
confession.reason: The confession was rejected, as stated.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life by the Trial Court

high_court_outcome.quote: dismissed the appeal and confirmed the conviction and sentence

final_outcome.quote: The Appellant is acquitted of all charges

offence_finally_established.quote: The Appellant is acquitted of all charges

imprisonment_type.quote: The Appellant is acquitted of all charges

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but the sarpanch denied meeting the victim; other witnesses said the sarpanch and others met the victim at about 10 PM.
neutral_facts.quote: This witness denied having met the deceased earlier “I have never met Shamsher Singh earlier”.
neutral_facts.reason: The sarpanch is wrongly said to have seen the victim earlier; he denied meeting him. Other facts are accurate.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the prescribed punishment.

physical_harm.quote: his throat having knotted with some cloth, and the right eye being badly injured

premeditation_planning.quote: planned to kill the deceased with the help of other accused
premeditation_planning.reason: This was only in the confession account, which was rejected.

motive.correct_value: alleged: A-2 owed money to the deceased and was under pressure to repay; the Court did not decide the motive.
motive.quote: it is not necessary to examine those aspects in detail
motive.reason: The Court did not examine motive; 'not accepted' overstates it.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: this is not an indication of the guilt
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Court accepted no inculpatory evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: He is certainly an unreliable witness.
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the assessments of PW-10, 11, 12 and 16.

post_offence_conduct.quote: surrendered before the investigating officer through Ex-Sarpanch
post_offence_conduct.reason: The surrender was alleged and the confession was found false.

trial_duration.reason: The offence date is 10.04.2004 per the judgment; the other dates match.

legal_representation.quote: Pranab Kumar Mullick, Mrs. Soma Mullick ... Ajay Bansal, A.A.G.

investigation_status.quote: Upon completion of investigation, charge sheet was filed.

procedural_irregularity.quote: he did not try to join any private person before carrying out the recoveries

appeal_history.quote: We, therefore, allow Criminal Appeal No. 1338 of 2010

prosecution_argument.reason: The State's arguments in the Supreme Court are not recorded.

defence_argument.quote: Mr. Mullick has also brought to our notice that the weapons recovered by the IO
defence_argument.reason: Matches the points raised by counsel.

legal_principle_applied.quote: however strong a suspicion may be, it cannot take place of a proof beyond reasonable doubt

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Pritinder Singh v. State of Punjab, (2023) 7 SCC 727

other_sentence_order.quote: his bail bonds, if any, stand discharged
